_notes: consultation (상담): rendered 'परामर्श' everywhere (was mixed काउंसलिंग/परामर्श); 'काउंसलिंग' kept out per glossary. Owner may prefer the loanword 'कंसल्टेशन' if the marketing locale uses it.

'counselor' in student-facing strings re-aligned to 'Hangyul टीम' / 'Hangyul Univ टीम' as the English now says; 'काउंसलर' kept only where the English itself says counselor (university console, agency waitingOn).

document review: student-facing strings now use one verb, 'जाँच' (was mixed समीक्षा/जाँच/सत्यापित); essay/profile review and all agency/university review-queue strings keep 'समीक्षा'. 'सत्यापित' reserved for official verification (agency verify action).
personal statement / study plan: unified to the loanwords 'पर्सनल स्टेटमेंट' / 'स्टडी प्लान' (already used in writing.subtitle); 'निबंध' kept only where the English says 'essays'.
managed application: three renderings unified to 'टीम के साथ तैयार और जमा किए जाने वाले आवेदन' (says what we do, no promise).

standard admission letter (표준입학허가서): 'स्टैंडर्ड एडमिशन लेटर (मानक प्रवेश पत्र)' on first mention in a string; plain 'admission letter' in English rendered 'एडमिशन लेटर' (was 'प्रवेश पत्र'/'प्रवेश प्रमाणपत्र').
consular legalization: 'कॉन्सुलर लीगलाइज़ेशन' (several strings had just 'सत्यापन', which drops the official term); apostille spelling unified to 'एपोस्टिल' (one string had 'अपॉस्टिल').
dormitory: kept the locale's existing 'डॉर्मिटरी'. Indian students say 'हॉस्टल'; owner decision whether to switch the whole locale (would also touch marketing/common).

student:v17.gate.named reframed as 'यह सुविधा प्लान में शामिल है: {{what}}।' so singular/plural {{what}} values agree; the gate.what.* values are now nominative. The old frame ('Hangyul {{what}} को प्लान के तहत संभालता है') did not match the English.

CROSS_BORDER_VERIFICATION.summary (mobile): the old Hindi listed 'items transferred, timing, retention' (Korean PIPA wording); aligned to the reviewed English ('Details, including how to refuse'). Owner to confirm the Korean legal text does not require the longer list.
mobile:login.networkError: old Hindi contained developer-only emulator instructions (10.0.2.2, LAN IP); replaced with the user-facing English meaning.
'Closes {{date}}' left as '{{date}} को बंद' and 'Due {{date}}' as 'अंतिम तारीख {{date}}' so application deadline and Hangyul due date stay distinct (glossary).

Agency 'waiting on' family rendered as '<party> की ओर से बाकी' (pending from X's side) for all views and waitingOn.* keys, which reads more naturally than a literal 'X की प्रतीक्षा में' for 'Waiting for us'.

Gendered verb forms avoided where a restructure was cheap (e.g. graduation statuses now 'पढ़ाई की स्थिति: पूरी हो चुकी है / जल्द पूरी हो रही है / अभी चल रही है'); remaining masculine defaults ('करते हैं') left as the locale's existing convention.
